content: Kahnimw en mehn Lipai kan
Kaunen peneinei kan en mehn Lipai ko ahpw patohla rehn samworo Eleasar oh rehn Sosua nein Nun oh rehn kaunen peneinei koaros en kadaudok kan en Israel.

Re ahpw patohwanohng irail nan Sailo, nan wehin Kenan, “KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses me se pahn patohwan ale kahnimw kei mehn wia wasahn at kousoan, iangahki wasa me nait mahn akan pahn kin mwengemwenge ie.”
Eri nin duwen koasoandi en KAUN-O, mehn Israel ko kihong mehn Lipai ko kahnimw kei oh sahpw sang nan pein sapwarail ko.
Peneinei en mehn Lipai ko me kisehn peneineien Kohad iei irail me tepin ale kahnimw kei. Peneinei kan me kadaudok en samworo Aaron ale kahnimw eisek siluh sang nan sapwen Suda, Simion oh Pensamin.
Luhwen peneineien Kohad ale kahnimw eisek sang nan sapwen Epraim, Dan oh palikapi en Manase.
Kahnimw eisek siluh kohieng peneineien Kerson sang nan sapwen Isakar, Aser, Napdali oh palimesehn Manase.
Kahnimw eisek riau sang nan sapwen Reupen, Kad oh Sepulon kohieng peneinei kan en peneineien Merari.
Mehn Israel kan kihong mehn Lipai kan kahnimw pwukat oh wasahn nair mahn akan en mwenge ie, sang ni usuhs,
nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses.
Ih met eden kahnimw kan sang sapwen Suda oh Simion me kohieng
kadaudok en Aaron kan me kisehn peneineien Kohad, me kadaudok en Lipai. Irail me tepin usuhs.
Re ahpw ale kahnimw Arpa (Arpa iei semen Anak), me ahnsou wet adaneki Epron, nan sahpw nahnahn Suda, iangahki sahpw me kapilpene mehn kamwenge mahn.
Ahpw mohs akan en kahnimwo iangahki kisin kahnimw kan kohiengehr sapwen Kalep nein Sepune.
Patehng Epron (ehu kahnimw en rukula), kahnimw kan me pahn sansal pah kohieng kadaudok kan en samworo Aaron: iei Lipna,
Sattir, Estemoa,
Olon, Depir,
Ain, Suhda, oh Ped Semes, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn akan: kahnimw duwau sang kadaudok en Suda oh Simion.
Re ale sang nan sapwen Pensamin kahnimw pahieu: Kipeon, Kepa,
Anadod oh Almon, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn akan.
Patpene wiahda kahnimw eisek siluh, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn akan me kohieng samworo kan me kisehn kadaudok en Aaron.
Peneinei teiko en Lipai peneineien Kohad ale kahnimw kei sang nan sapwen Epraim.
Kahnimw pahieu kohieng irail: Sekem oh sapwen kamwenge mahn nan sahpw nahnahn Epraim (ehu kahnimw en rukula), Keser,
Kipsaim oh Ped Oron, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sahpw pahieu sang sapwen Dan: Eldeke, Kippedon,
Aisalon, oh Kadrimmon, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale kahnimw riau sang ni Palikapi en Manase: Taanak oh Kadrimmon, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Peneinei pwukat en peneineien Kohad ale kahnimw eisek, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Pil ehu pwihn en Lipai, peneineien Kerson ale sang nan sapwen Palimesehn Manase kahnimw riau: Kolan nan Pasan (ehu kahnimw en rukula) oh Peestera, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sang nan sapwen Isakar kahnimw pahieu: iei Kision, Daperad,
Sarmud oh Enannim, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sang nan sapwen Aser kahnimw pahieu: Misal, Apdon,
Elkad oh Rehop, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sang nan sapwen Napdali kahnimw siluh: Kedes nan Kalili, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn (ehu kahnimw en rukula), Ammod Dor, oh Kardan, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Ekei peneinei sang peneineien Kerson ale kahnimw eisek siluh iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Luhwen mehn Lipai kan, peneineien Merari ale sang sapwen Sepulon kahnimw pahieu: Sokneam, Karta,
Dimna, oh Nahalal, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sang nan sapwen Reupen kahnimw pahieu: Peser, Sahas,
Kedemod oh Mepaad, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Re ale sang ni kadaudok en Kad kahnimw pahieu: Ramod nan Kilead iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn (ehu kahnimw en rukula), Mahanaim.
Espon oh Saser, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn.
Eri, kahnimw koaros me kohieng peneineien Merari patpene wiahda kahnimw eisek riau.
Nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen mehn Israel ko, kahnimw kan patpene wiahda me pahisek waluh, iangahki sapwen kamwenge mahn akan me kapilirailpene, iei me kohieng mehn Lipai kan.
Israel Alehdi Sahpw
KAUN-O eri ketikihong mehn Israel ko sahpw koaros me e ketin inoukihong arail pahpa kahlap ako me e pahn ketikihong irail. Ni ar alehdier sahpw pwukat, re ahpw soandiong wasao.

KAUN-O ketikihong irail meleilei oh popohl nan sahpwo pwon, nin duwen me e ketin inoukihong arail pahpa kahlap ako. Sohte imwintihti men sang rehn arail imwintihti kan koaros kak pelianirailda, pwe KAUN-O ketikihong mehn Israel ko roson en powehdi ar imwintihti kan koaros.
KAUN-O ketin kapwaiada inou koaros me e ketin wiahiong mehn Israel ko.
